chapter: Famous Door, the union dispute and Stuff Smith's last years
title: Stuff's tear gas gun in the hotel kitchen
summary: Stuff fired a tear gas gun in the kitchen next to the dressing room, making cooks and waiters cry; the manager told Jones he would fire them all but for the business.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Now we come to the Netherlands Plaza in Cincinnati.
No, wait a minute. What about the shotgun?

Oh, yeah. In there we did everything. As I say, we went in there, we went to the bar. People started asking us to sit at the tables, and so Smith couldn't say no because these are the big customers, and they're going to say what is this, they can't sit over here, you know. Can't sit at a table? We'd like to talk to him, you know. And then Stuff was hanging out all day and bought him a tear gas gun. He comes in at night and our dressing room's right off the kitchen, and he goes out in the kitchen, and the waiters are running through there, you know. A lot of dinners are being served and they're running back and forth. And he shoots off his tear gas gun, and everybody's crying. The waiters is crying, the cooks is crying, and Mr. Smith starts back there and says, "What's going on back there?" They said, "Don't go in there. Don't go in there." He said, "Why?"
